findings.title: Plugin request log fields keep their source after the move to the contextual logger
findings.description:
The old `logRequest` added `pluginId`, `endpoint`, `uname`, `dsName`, `dsUID` and `traceID` itself. The new code logs with `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. The same fields now come from two places:
- `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` (`contextual_logger_middleware.go:27-37`) attaches them via `log.WithContextualAttributes`. The infra logger reads them through the provider registered in `pkg/infra/log/log.go:55-61`, and `ConcreteLogger.FromContext` (`log.go:203-217`) turns them into key/value pairs.
- `traceID` comes from the provider registered in `tracing.ProvideService` (`pkg/infra/tracing/tracing.go:91-97`). That constructor is wired at `pkg/server/wire.go:249`.

Chain order is correct. `reverseMiddlewares` (`pkg/plugins/manager/client/decorator.go:106-111`) makes the first list entry outermost, so the chain is Tracing → Metrics → ContextualLogger → Logger (`pluginsintegration.go:157-161`). The same four endpoints are instrumented as before. `FromContext` builds a new logger with `cl.New`, so the shared named logger is not mutated between requests.

The precondition is that `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` stays above `LoggerMiddleware`. Without it, the completed-request log silently loses those fields. Today the only chain construction is `pluginsintegration.go:161`.

findings.title: Plugin `Logger` interface change compiles against every implementer
findings.description:
The new `FromContext` method is implemented by both `grafanaInfraLogWrapper` (`pkg/plugins/log/logger.go:48`) and `TestLogger` (`pkg/plugins/log/fake.go:46`). I searched for other implementers of the plugin `Logger`:
- The `logWrapper` types in `coreplugin/registry.go` and `grpcplugin/log_wrapper.go` consume `plog.Logger`; they do not implement it.
- The `kvstore` test fake returns `NewTestLogger()`.

The rename is complete. No non-test code references `InstrumentationMiddleware` or `NewInstrumentationMiddleware`. `metrics_middleware_test.go:78` calls `newMetricsMiddleware`, which exists at `metrics_middleware.go:32`. The imports in the changed files all remain in use.

findings.title: `TestLogger.FromContext` returns a detached logger, so calls made through it are not recorded
findings.description: `FromContext` ignores its receiver and returns `NewTestLogger()`. Before this change, `LoggerMiddleware` called `m.logger.Info` directly, which recorded into `TestLogger.InfoLogs`. Now the only call site (`logger_middleware.go:58`) writes to a detached logger, so a test that injects a `TestLogger` into `NewLoggerMiddleware` would see `InfoLogs.Calls == 0`. No current caller does this: `NewLoggerMiddleware` is only called at `pluginsintegration.go:161` with a real logger, so nothing fails today. The fake's `New` (`fake.go:18-20`) already detaches in the same way, so this follows an existing convention. If the fake should record calls, `FromContext` could return `f`.
